description: Nuclear Science explores the atom and radiation: radiation and dose, atoms and isotopes, particle accelerators, classic experiments like cloud chambers, radiation safety and radon, nuclear energy, and how nuclear science helps in medicine, industry and space.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Radiation
requirements.summary: Ionizing and nonionizing radiation, ALARA, the radiation symbol and estimating your annual dose.

requirements.title: Nuclear basics
requirements.summary: Key terms and building models of isotopes.

requirements.title: Particle physics
requirements.summary: How accelerators work, and visiting a facility or researching accelerators.

requirements.title: Classic experiments
requirements.summary: Two options: an electroscope, a cloud chamber or a half-life demonstration.

requirements.title: Radiation safety
requirements.summary: One option: a shielding test, a radon study or an X-ray facility visit.

requirements.title: Nuclear energy
requirements.summary: One option on fission or a power plant visit, and how nuclear power makes electricity.

requirements.title: Beneficial uses
requirements.summary: Uses in medicine, the environment, industry, space and radiation therapy.
